newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close mixed after late recovery.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close mixed after late recovery.

text.p: LIFFE wheat futures ended a short pre-holiday session mixed after shipper short-covering in the last minutes of trade reversed earlier currency-driven weakness.
Wheat and barley futures markets closed at 1230 Tuesday and will reopen Thursday, January 2.
Sterling's strength against continental currencies took front month Jan down to 94.45 stg per tonne before shippers came in and pushed it back up to end 0.15 stg higher at 95 stg.
"You can't read too much into it," one trader said. "The volume wasn't there to show a true change in trend."
The expectation that sterling would continue to push higher against the mark was continuing to dampen the market's price expectations, he said.
Active May, which traded 58 lots, last traded 0.15 lower at 99.05, having seen a low of 98.80 stg.
Barley benefited from the same late recovery, with front month January most active, trading 6 out of 11 lots and ending 0.40 stg higher at 93.20 stg, from a low of 92.50
